_schema: LAW ME layout benchmark ground-truth (per page). Fill from the OFFICIAL PDF, not from any extractor output.
confirmed_stratum: one of: classic_marginal_caption | modern_two_column | complex_modern | old_font | doubled_text_layer | budget_table | image_partial | front_or_index
reading_order_text: Full correct RTL reading-order transcription of the page body (captions excluded).

regions.bbox_or_desc: e.g. marginal section heading, right margin

marginal_captions: section headings as printed in the margin
section_boundaries: section numbers in reading order, e.g. 1, 2, 3, 9א
hebrew_fidelity_notes: glyph corruption / ambiguous characters observed on the page
